items.summary: Added Run 15 full report and one library record across List, Table and Calendar. Route-first choice and six-row decision/access/review matrix now precede six unchanged, untested cards. Corrected mutable emails source badge to 2.1.1 viewed 5 Oct; pin/inventory unknown; historical Copywriting 2.0.2 pin qualified. No seventh card or package test.

Added Run 14 full report and one Research library record across List, Table and Calendar. For one approved local landing-page draft, a maintained brief/template and reviewed prompt are first; third-party Copywriting 2.1.0 is conditional, with current pin/inventory, numeric assertions, installation and quality unverified. Six cards and 13 prior report URLs retained.

Added Run 13 decision to defer a competitor messaging-change brief skill search. A dated, authorized source-paired review is coherent, but saved diffs, a versioned sheet, reviewed prompt and page monitors remain credible alternatives. No seventh card, package search or monitor test.

Added Run 12 decision to defer a prelaunch setup-QA skill search and keep cross-channel UTM governance separate. A local approved-brief-to-setup comparison can surface draft discrepancies, not live launch readiness. No seventh card, package search, connection or test.

Practitioner evidence supports brief-making but not unmet need for a portable package over templates, reviewed prompts or connected tools. Defined a low-access first use and next prelaunch-QA question. Six cards unchanged; no package sought or tested.

Added Run 10 bounded source-text review of ClawFu report-generator and Digital Marketing Pro analytics-insights. Neither meets the offline briefing audit, trace, low-access and authorized-owner approval gates. Search closed for now; no seventh card, synthetic test, or recheck of six existing entries.

Added Run 9 source-text comparison of Anthropic performance-report and Skill Me agency-monthly-report for the fixed offline briefing job. Neither meets the traceability, reconciliation and approval gates; no seventh card, install recommendation, test, or recheck of the six existing entries.

Added Run 8 research on a narrowly scoped offline monthly cross-channel briefing job for a later SKILL.md search. The six-entry catalogue, Run 7 freshness limits, Superamped provenance stops, and conditional draft-only email boundary remain. No reporting package was inspected or tested.

Added Run 7 source and package-surface recheck. No substantive catalogue claim changed; all six selected-directory listings lacked current-day verification, and two selected file pages plus the Superamped README were stale. The four Superamped install-stop caveats and conditional, draft-only email boundary remain.

Added a conditional, draft-only Core Haines `emails` candidate for a future lifecycle/email catalogue entry. It requires an owner-approved non-personal brief and human approval before any email-system action; RampStack `email-sequences` is excluded. The four Superamped provenance caveats remain unchanged.
Added a provenance-only recheck for the four Superamped entries. No selected-file SHA/date or tag finding was established; the stop before an install recommendation remains.
Added a safe evaluation boundary and host-assumption report: stop before an install recommendation for the four Superamped entries, and require human approval for every external action.
Added a five-skill comparison report, a practical chooser, and List, Table, and Calendar views for the permanent research library.
Expanded the first marketing-skill catalogue with job browsing, a visible research library, and methods and limits pages.
